Mira: quick async — question about tool/function call param fallbacks in chat/completions streaming.
Mira: In streaming delta we emit `{'event':'toolcall_start','tool':'search','params': ...}`. For cases where user code intentionally passes `null` for params, should we emit ` \"params\": null ` or omit `params` entirely? Some clients treat null vs missing differently.
Alex: lean toward omitting for empty/absent args. avoids breaking clients that do schema validation. keep `params` only when non-empty.
Jamal: +1 but we should add an explicit `params_present: false` flag in the delta if we remove the field so consumers can distinguish omitted vs absent-by-bug. That avoids ambiguity.
Mira: huh, was thinking that adds extra surface area. Any other ideas?
Alex: alternative: always include `params` but make it `{}` when empty — preserves shape. downside: can't tell null-intent vs empty-map-intent.
Mira: examples please — can someone paste small delta shapes?
Jamal: sure
Jamal: ```json
{"event":"toolcall_start","tool":"search","params":null}
```
Jamal: vs
Jamal: ```json
{"event":"toolcall_start","tool":"search"}
```
Alex: or
Alex: ```json
{"event":"toolcall_start","tool":"search","params":{}}
```
Mira: Implementation-wise, runtime currently outputs `params: null` when args==null. If we change to omit, we'll need a minor runtime flag and compat test.
Alex: I'll open a tiny PR for the runtime toggle + docs note. Dev-bot: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/5123 created by Alex.
Dev-bot: CI: tests/streaming/compat -> failing on new client fixture
Mira: Jamal, can you take the compat harness + update evals for streaming deltas? I can update docs + console examples.
Jamal: assigned, will send a PR tomorrow. Also propose we add a unit in the spec `streaming.toolcall.params = optional` and an appendix about `null` vs missing.
Alex: sgtm. one more ask: add a quick tslint rule for SDK that flags `params: null` usage to make migration easier.
Mira: cool. I'll note in the API changelog and schedule a 15m sync if any blockers. Thanks :thumbsup:
Infra-Bot: rolling patch to runtime feature-flag in staging — deploy id stg-2024-09-06-31
Mira: closing loop — will update here when PRs merge.
